title: Frontend: Strategy Backtest Page
description: Create the main StrategyBacktestPage.tsx page with config form (indicator params, rule builder, stock/date/cash inputs) and results display (metric cards, equity curve placeholder, trade table placeholder). Register /strategy-backtest route in App.tsx with DockNav.

criteria: StrategyBacktestPage.tsx renders config form with fields: stock code, start_date, end_date, initial_cash, commission_rate, slippage_rate
Config form includes indicator configuration section: MA periods, MACD fast/slow/signal, KDJ n/k/d, BOLL period/stddev
Config form includes rule builder section for buy_rules and sell_rules with dropdown-based condition creation
Page displays metric cards: total_return, max_drawdown, win_rate, trade_count after running backtest
Page shows loading state during backtest execution and error state on failure
Page uses Tailwind dark theme matching existing BacktestPage.tsx style
Chinese UI labels throughout (matching existing pages)
/strategy-backtest route registered in App.tsx with DockNav navigation item
Page follows existing page component patterns (function component, hooks for state)
convergence.verification: Page renders at /strategy-backtest with form and DockNav shows new tab
convergence.definition_of_done: Strategy backtest page accessible via route with full config form and result display
